hypotheses.title: Procaine HCl extends Drosophila lifespan via monoamine oxidase inhibition
hypotheses.claim: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting monoamine oxidase and reducing oxidative stress. The lifespan extension depends on these combined molecular actions.
hypotheses.rationale: Monoamine oxidase inhibition can preserve monoamine signalling and lower reactive oxygen species generation, both linked to slower ageing. Reduced oxidative stress is a recognised route to extended longevity.
hypotheses.prediction: Treated flies will live significantly longer than controls, with measurable monoamine oxidase inhibition and reduced oxidative stress markers.
hypotheses.experiment: Administer procaine HCl to adult flies and compare lifespan, monoamine oxidase activity, and oxidative stress markers against untreated controls and flies receiving a structurally related inactive analogue.

hypotheses.title: Black tea extract extends Drosophila melanogaster lifespan
hypotheses.claim: Black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Supplementation with the extract increases mean and maximum lifespan relative to untreated flies.
hypotheses.rationale: Black tea contains polyphenols with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that can counter molecular damage accumulating with age. Such compounds are plausible dietary modulators of longevity.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies receiving black tea extract will show significantly longer mean and maximum lifespan than untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Supplement the diet of age-matched adult flies with black tea extract at several doses and compare survival curves with control flies on standard medium.

hypotheses.title: O6-benzylguanine extends Drosophila melanogaster lifespan
hypotheses.claim: O6-benzylguanine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Exposure to the compound increases survival of treated flies relative to controls.
hypotheses.rationale: O6-benzylguanine modulates DNA repair pathways, and improved maintenance of genomic integrity is a plausible mechanism for slowing age-related decline and extending survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Treated flies will exhibit significantly longer lifespans than untreated controls across the survival experiment.
hypotheses.experiment: Administer O6-benzylguanine in the diet of adult flies and compare survival curves with vehicle-treated controls under identical conditions.

hypotheses.title: Procaine HCl extends Drosophila melanogaster lifespan
hypotheses.claim: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Adult flies exposed to the compound live significantly longer than untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Procaine HCl can influence cellular membrane properties and monoamine metabolism, processes implicated in ageing. Any intervention stabilising age-related physiological decline could extend survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies receiving procaine HCl will show significantly increased mean and maximum lifespan compared with controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Treat adult flies with procaine HCl in their medium and compare lifespan with vehicle-treated controls maintained under identical conditions.

hypotheses.title: Procaine HCl shortens Drosophila melanogaster lifespan
hypotheses.claim: Procaine HCl shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Adult flies exposed to the compound show reduced survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Procaine HCl can perturb neuronal membrane function and monoamine balance, and such disruption may impose physiological stress that accelerates ageing and reduces survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies receiving procaine HCl will show significantly decreased mean and maximum lifespan compared with controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Treat adult flies with procaine HCl in their medium and compare survival curves with vehicle-treated controls maintained under identical conditions.

hypotheses.title: Black tea extract extends Drosophila lifespan via insulin/IGF signalling
hypotheses.claim: Black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inducing the insulin/IGF signalling pathway. The lifespan extension depends on activation of this pathway.
hypotheses.rationale: Insulin/IGF signalling regulates growth, metabolism and stress responses, and its modulation can alter ageing rate. Compounds in black tea may activate this pathway to influence longevity.
hypotheses.prediction: Treated flies will live significantly longer than controls and show measurable induction of insulin/IGF pathway activity.
hypotheses.experiment: Supplement adult flies with black tea extract and compare lifespan and insulin/IGF pathway readouts with controls, including pathway-mutant flies to test dependence.
